review_candidates.title: Endpoint Operations Administrator III
review_candidates.description: AAA Club Alliance is currently seeking a full-time Endpoint Operations Admin III to join our team at one of the following locations: Columbus, OH; Cincinnati, OH; or Wilmington, DE. This position follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring on-site presence three days per week, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. The primary duties of the role are to: Design modern desktop and mobile device management (MDM) solutions using Windows 11, MECM/SCCM, and Intune. Design, develop and implement modern lifecycle practices for endpoints. Perform Software / Hardware testing, modifications, and system integrity checks between the hardware, security applications, and operating systems and drivers. Troubleshoot and resolve endpoint issues, problems and errors, by examining system performance, RAM usage, and incompatibilities. Research new and up and coming technologies. Gather business, communication and functional objectives by leading client working sessions, reviewing the competitive landscape, and creative brainstorming sessions with the project team. Design how technologies will fit into the ACA environment. Partner with architects from other platforms such as network, server, security, telephony etc. Develop the high-level implementation plans for desktop platform. Evaluate new and existing technologies as part of the architecture team, understanding how they will impact the computing environment at ACA. Remain abreast of Microsoft best practices. Provide overall guidance with modern desktop platform. Build Group Policy desktop management policies; partner with Server Engineering for overall group policy management. Assist with transfer and management of GPO into Configuration Policies in Intune. Operate and maintain Microsoft SCCM and related environments including distribution points, cloud mgmt. gateway, Intune, Auto pilot including analysis, administration and support. Serve as the Tier 3 point of escalation for Tier 1 and 2. Ensure security compliance is maintained. Install, configure, and prepare operating systems for deployment with SCCM and Intune. Responsible for designs; creates PowerShell scripts and packages to handle upgrades. Proactive security patch management and vulnerability remediation. Participate in tiger team to manage enterprise vulnerabilities. Manage issues related to malware prevention, protection, and recovery. Ability to serve as a Tier 3 technical escalation and lead enterprise endpoint management initiatives. Plan, develop, build, deploy and track success of application packages. Build and deploy using PowerShell. Conduct zero touch deployments. Utilize Intune management for various tasks. Research and resolve vulnerabilities related to the end user computing environment Manage distribution points including Cloud Management Gateway. Monitor and report on compliance reports, Windows updates, PCI, 3rd party updates Research and improve endpoint images based on business requirements. Perform post-resolution follow-ups on tickets to ensure resolutions remain successful Adhere to Change Management Process. Provide reporting and metrics documentation. Create and update knowledgebase documentation. Acknowledges and abides by all Information Security Policies. Other duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or higher in IT or related field. A combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Minimum of 6 years of experience administering Endpoint Management systems required. Experience with desktop architecture. Expert-level experience with Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows 11, and Autopilot. Experience designing and managing modern desktop and mobile device management (MDM) solutions. Strong knowledge of endpoint lifecycle management, deployment, configuration, and support. Advanced PowerShell scripting and automation experience. Experience supporting SCCM/MECM environments, including distribution points and Cloud Management Gateway. Must have SCCM, Intune, Entra, PowerShell, and AVD experience. At AAA, your success is our success. What we can offer you: The starting base compensation for this position is $69,370 to $101,058. *The base pay range shown is a guideline for compensation and ultimate salary offered will be based on factors such as applicant experience and geographic location* Comprehensive health benefits package. Up to three weeks of paid time off accrued during your first year. Annual Bonus Plan. 401(K) plan with company match up to 7%. Professional development opportunities and tuition reimbursement. Paid time off to volunteer & company-sponsored volunteer events throughout the year. Other benefits include a free AAA Premier Membership, Health & Wellness Program, Health Concierge Service, Health & Life Insurance, Short Term/Long Term Disability. Full time Associates are offered a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Medical, Dental, and Vision plan options Up to 2 weeks Paid parental leave 401k plan with company match up to 7% 2+ weeks of PTO within your first year Paid company holidays Company provided volunteer opportunities + 1 volunteer day per year Free AAA Membership Continual learning reimbursement up to $5,250 per year And MORE! Check out our Benefits Page for more information ACA is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment practices laws. At ACA, we are committed to cultivating a welcoming and inclusive workplace of team members with diverse backgrounds and experiences to enable us to meet our goals and support our values while serving our Members and customers. We strive to attract and retain candidates with a passion for their work and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. It is ACA’s policy to employ the best qualified individuals available for all positions. Hiring decisions are based upon ACA’s operating needs, and applicant qualifications including, but not limited to, experience, skills, ability, availability, cooperation, and job performance.

review_candidates.title: Site Reliability Engineer II (SRE)
review_candidates.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer II to join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Organization. In this role as an individual contributor, you will guide the reliability and performance of our infrastructure and software systems across several engineering teams and influence decisions across our technology organization. You will utilize your technical skills and expertise to help us build reliable and flexible infrastructure solutions that empower our technology organization to quickly and safely deploy new features for our customers. Responsibilities Take ownership of assigned problem statements and drive them to completion with guidance from senior engineers. Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code while improving existing systems and features. Accurately estimate timelines for features and tasks, learning to balance effort, risk, and impact. Collaborate effectively across teams, communicating clearly on progress, blockers, and outcomes. Seek and apply feedback from peers and managers to improve code quality, technical skills, and delivery consistency. Support team members and contribute to a positive, learning-oriented team culture. Take ownership of personal development goals, showing steady progress in technical and problem-solving skills. Demonstrate accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement in all aspects of your work. Develop, configure, and maintain underlying platforms for deployed software (AWS accounts and networking, kubernetes clusters, and similar systems). Develop, configure, and maintain observability and monitoring tools (Coralogix, Sentry, etc.). Develop, configure, and maintain software development (CI/CD) tools (github actions runners, ArgoCD, etc). Qualifications Required: 3+ years of professional experience in infrastructure management or backend software development experience in a fast-paced, product-driven environment. Demonstrated technical expertise in one or more of the following languages: Python, Javascript, or Unix Shell. Experience with AWS, including deploying, monitoring, and scaling production workloads. General experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker. Comfortable working in an operational environment, including participation in an on-call schedule. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, comfortable engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $135,000 - $155,000 annually + commission depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

review_candidates.title: Oracle Financial Consultant
review_candidates.description: Senior Oracle Financials Consultant Job Purpose The Senior Oracle Financials Consultant will lead the design, implementation, configuration, and optimization of Oracle Financial applications. Acting as the core bridge between finance stakeholders and technical teams, this individual will translate complex accounting and business requirements into scalable Oracle solutions. The ideal candidate brings extensive full-lifecycle implementation experience, strong techno-functional or functional expertise, and a deep understanding of core corporate finance processes. Key Responsibilities Solution Design & Implementation: Lead end-to-end full lifecycle implementations, upgrades, or migrations of Oracle Financials (Fusion or EBS R12 and Cloud ERP will be value add). Business Process Mapping: Conduct requirement-gathering workshops, fit-gap analysis, and future-state business process design across core finance streams: Record-to-Report (R2R) Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Order-to-Cash (O2C) Module Configuration: Own the hands-on configuration and optimization of core Oracle Financial modules, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Cash Management (CM), Fixed Assets (FA), and Subledger Accounting (SLA). Technical Collaboration: Partner with developers to define technical specifications for RICEW objects (Reports, Interfaces, Customizations, Extensions, Workflows) and data migration scripts. Reporting & Analytics: Design and build financial statements, dashboards, and operational reports using tools like OTBI, Financial Reporting Studio (FRS), Smart View, or BI Publisher. Testing & Quality Assurance: Lead System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, including test script creation, execution management, and defect resolution. Change Management & Training: Develop comprehensive training documentation, deliver end-user workshops, and guide the business through cutover planning, go-live, and hypercare support phases. Strategic Advisor: Keep up-to-date with Oracle's quarterly release cycles (for Cloud) to evaluate new features, assess impact on existing processes, and advise leadership on system optimization. Required Experience & Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. (An MBA or CPA/CMA certification is a strong plus). Experience: * Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Oracle Financials. Proven track record of leading at least 2–3 full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud or EBS R12 Financial implementations. Functional Expertise: Deep understanding of accounting principles, consolidation, intercompany eliminations, multi-currency setups, and corporate tax configurations. System Knowledge: Master-level familiarity Oracle EBS Financials (Oracle Cloud ERP, Fusion, will be a plus). Experience with Oracle EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) is highly advantageous. Reporting Tools: Proficiency with Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI), Smart View, and SQL queries for data verification.

Job Description Must be open to working all shifts The hourly rate for this position is $28.00/hr, shift differential for 2nd shift is $1.00 and 3rd shift is $1.50/hr Summary The Maintenance Technical Support Coordinator IV position is responsible for taking complete ownership of all Tier 2 emergency roadside cases, from start to finish. This position has the authority and autonomy to determine whether we send an internal technician for call out or send the work to a third party. The function of this position is to resolve technical related problems on Ryder lease or contract vehicles stemming from manufacture quality, engineering shortcomings, manufacturing defects, misapplication as well as general reliability, durability or other operational issues. Using strong maintenance knowledge and various proven problem solving processes, they will address and resolve customer roadside unit breakdown or system failure issues via telephonic communication with customers in breakdown situations, identifying and executing the best course of action to resolve the issue or problem and will as a result, improve the customer experience with quick uptime results. Essential Functions Assess research, trouble-shoot and remedy vehicle roadside breakdowns handled through Ryder Customer Response Center (RCRC) with full autonomy of decisions related to cost and responsible to improving customer uptime Assist with follow ups, escalations, service provider interactions in partnership with RCRC agents and leadership. Provide periodic summaries and analysis to the maintenance team to improve breakdowns, OEM quality, and warranty issues. Provide updated technical knowledge to the maintenance team, including OEM provided information, internal technical training, technical bulletins, infoCenter and other sources for training and development. Mentor the Tier 1 call center team. Provide status updates, participate in other meetings, and provide periodic training. Additional Responsibilities Performs other duties as assigned. Skills And Abilities Highly technical skills with expertise experience related to Ryder fleet assets Expertise in refrigeration, lift gate, electrical, after-treatment systems, OEM platform and Ryder technical certifications/qualifications (PM, Brake, Tire & Wheel, A/C, Battery Charge & Check, etc.) Ability to elicit and understand detailed descriptions/communications from customer drivers and/or dispatchers related to unit issues/breakdown detail Ability to communicate and direct recommendations for driver initiated “fixes” to units based on the diagnostic communications in a safe and clear manner; Strong interpersonal, listening and analytical communication skills Ability to identify and communicate necessary technical needs and required tools to address the mechanical issues relayed from the driver Working knowledge of vendor recommendations related to specific customer unit breakdown needs based on equipment and part needs Ability to analyze and recommend out service/towing solutions vson-call mobile technician Ability to diagnose, recommend and communicate mechanical and electrical repair recommendations with minimal (if any) support utilizing diagnostic and technical expertise experience; Must possess demonstrated analytical and repair skills in overall vehicle maintenance Active learner and ability to stay abreast of new product and technology advancements in the industry by participating in training opportunities to maintain technical expertise related to new and changing unit technology Ability to speak, understand, read and write English Ability to speak, understand, read and write Spanish (preferred) Ability to calmly manage and influence high pressure environment in addressing critical customer breakdown issues; review_candidates.title: In Service Support Technician
review_candidates.description: Req ID: 526804 Location: Soho Depot, Birmingham Appointment Basis: Permanent Apply by: 15/09/2026 Salary + Benefits: circa £60,000 plus excellent benefits At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars. Your future role You’ll report to the Outstations and Planning Manager, and work alongside other members of the Services Central Engineering team. The role will be to provide technical expertise and support to the project monitoring, recording and reacting to in service failures on the new Class 730 fleet. Alstom is dedicated to ensure a successful and safe delivery of its services to its customer and to the achievement of its business plan and this role shall be pivotal in achieving this. We’ll look to you for: Ensuring work is performed in a safe and effective manner in accordance with the Health & Safety at Work Act (1974), Electricity at Work Regulations (1989), Railway Group Standards, and relevant ALSTOM Procedures. Technical telephone support line to assist drivers and customer issues. Continual monitoring of units in service utilising Fleet Monitor tracking system. Provide technical support to the depot teams in the provision of fault finding expertise and assistance with train repair activities. Have extensive knowledge of 3 phase, single phase and DC power systems and control systems. Detailed recording of faults, fault reporting, data gathering and verbal communication. Carry out fault finding and investigate intermittent faults on vehicles in service. Control and monitor repeat failures of units. Organise and control all aspects of failures in service. Liaising with the on duty Production Manager to determine rescue plan of failed units and subsequent replacement units. Attendance and assistance to be provided to failed units in service. Contribute to increase the rolling stock reliability and to prevent anomalies in commercial services. Provide on train fault diagnosis/rectification for units in service. Investigate technical problems as instructed by the project support engineering team. Partake in gathering required data downloads on critical performance systems. Undertake test runs to assist in fault finding and resolution of faults, in particular the closeout of repeat failures. Provide technical support in connection with special checks and experiments. Liaise with the systems support engineers and specialist engineers as necessary, gathering technical information needed to enable technical problems with trains, procedures, materials or component problems to be resolved. Carry out all duties in accordance with the Train Care Centre quality and safety procedures. Assist the Warranty Engineer in the execution of his responsibilities. Where necessary drive the companies vehicle to attend outstations or to attend failed units All About You We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: Electrical based NVQ Level 3 in rolling stock/aircraft or equivalent Practical experience and a sound knowledge of mechanical, electrical and electronic engineering aspects of modern Electric Multiple Units. IT skills – competent user of Personal Computer, including office packages, e-mail and intranet. Technical experience and strong knowledge in mechanical and electrical engineering. Flexibility and Adaptability. Enjoys variety in work practices, opinions and approaches Self-Motivation. Carries out, using own initiative, activities that add value to the job Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also: Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues Contribute to innovative projects Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension) Up to 52 weeks full maternity and adoption pay 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the opportunity to buy or sell holiday A wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you! Equal opportunity statement: Alstom is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all our employees are encouraged to reach their full potential, and individual differences are valued and respected. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local law. As a 'Disability Confident' employer, we will interview all disabled job applicants who match the essential criteria of the job description or specification. We will consider flexible working requests for all roles unless operational requirements prevent otherwise.

review_candidates.title: Customer Success Manager
review_candidates.description: About ISpeedToLead iSpeedToLead is a two-sided real estate lead marketplace operating across the United States. Sellers of motivated-seller leads list on one side, and real estate investors buy on the other. We are a bootstrapped, profitable product company with an engineering and analytics team that ships fast and makes decisions from data rather than opinion. About The Role This is the first dedicated Customer Success hire at iSpeedToLead. Today, buyers are supported reactively: tickets get answered, credits get issued, and nobody owns what happens to an account between its first purchase and its last one. You will own the post-purchase relationship with our buyers. That means onboarding them properly, keeping high-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it. One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two. Key Responsibilities Onboarding and activation Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase. Run onboarding calls and follow-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively. Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts. Account health and retention Manage a book of high-value accounts with regular check-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach. Build and maintain a health-scoring model that flags at-risk accounts before they churn, not after. Run save conversations on at-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code. Escalations and problem-solving Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues. Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution. Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data. Voice of the customer Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list. Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations. Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn. Process and reporting Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win-back, and escalation. Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems. Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them. Collaboration Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns. Partner with product and analytics on lifecycle experiments and instrumentation. Requirements 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Retention in a high-volume, low-ACV environment such as a marketplace, self-serve SaaS, or transactional product with hundreds of accounts. (Enterprise CSM experience with a handful of large logos is a different job and will not transfer well here.) Demonstrated ownership of a retention, churn, or repeat-purchase metric. You can describe what it was, what you changed, and what it became. Comfortable working with data: SQL basics or strong BI fluency (Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, BigQuery, or similar). You pull your own numbers rather than requesting them. Experience building a process from zero, such as an onboarding flow, a save playbook, or a health-score model. Executing someone else's process is not the same thing. Written and spoken English at C1 level, customer-facing, at volume. Confident on the phone with US small-business customers. Our buyers are real estate investors: direct, busy, and blunt. Practical use of AI tools in your daily workflow (call summarisation, drafting, triage) with examples you can show. A minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time. Nice to have Experience in real estate, proptech, lead generation, or a marketplace with wallet or prepaid-balance mechanics. Familiarity with Intercom, HubSpot, or a comparable CRM and support stack. Experience designing lifecycle email or automation flows. Ukrainian or Russian in addition to English. What we offer Full ownership of a metric that shows up directly in the P&L, with no layer between you and leadership. A greenfield function. You design how Customer Success works here. Real data infrastructure and an AI-native team, so arguments get settled with numbers and tooling is not a fight. A clear 12-month growth path to Head of Retention or Head of Customer Success, including automation of the low-touch tier and one to two direct reports. Remote work with flexible hours inside the required US overlap. Referral bonus of USD 3,000 after probation for anyone you bring in.
